title: KYC Name Match
description: Stops a KYC or PAN–Aadhaar submission failing on a name that doesn't match the documents, by comparing the typed name with each document word by word (order, initials, a missing middle name, transliterations like Laxmi and Lakshmi), checking the PAN's 4th and 5th letters against the holder type and surname, flagging a date of birth or gender that differs between documents (which UIDAI says must be identical), and offering each document's exact name in one tap.
